Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.query

Class Processor

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.query.Processor
Direct Known Subclasses:
PostgresProcessor, SQLiteProcessor
public class Processor extends Object
Turns the raw results of a query into what the builder returns.

The base processor passes rows through. A database module extends it where its database reports results its own way, for example the id of an inserted row.

Instances hold no state and are safe to share between threads, unless a subclass says otherwise.

    • processInsertGetId

      public Object processInsertGetId(Builder query, String sql, List<Object> values, String sequence)
      Runs an insert of one row and returns the new key.

      Laravel's base processor runs the insert and asks PDO for the last insert id. JDBC has no portable equivalent, and the right way differs per database (returning, or last_insert_rowid() on the same session), so this is the seam a database module's processor fills.

      Parameters:
      query - the query, never null
      sql - the compiled insert, never null
      values - the prepared bindings, never null
      sequence - the key column, never null
      Returns:
      the new key: a Long when it is numeric, else as the database returned it
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - always, in the base
      Implementation Requirements:
      The base refuses. An override runs sql with values through query.getConnection(), or a connection pinned to one session when the key is read by a second statement, and returns the key through toId(Object).
